instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Bend your elbows and hold your hands at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
3. Press your hands straight up until your arms are fully extended overhead.
4. Squeeze your shoulders at the top.
5. Lower your hands back to shoulder height with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you press up and inhale as you lower.
2. Keep your core tight to protect your lower back.
3. Keep your head and spine aligned, do not lean back.
4. Press in a straight vertical path.

instructions:
1. Start in a plank with hands slightly wider than shoulders and feet hip-width apart.
2. Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the floor.
3. Push your hips up and back into a downward-dog position, forming an inverted V.
4. Lower your hips and bring your body forward back to the plank.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your core engaged so your hips do not sag in the plank.
2. Lower your chest with control before sweeping forward.
3. Drive your hips up high with arms and legs straight in the V position.
4. Move smoothly through each phase.

instructions:
1. Start in a plank with hands under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
2. Drive your right knee toward your chest.
3. Return your right foot to the plank.
4. Drive your left knee toward your chest.
5. Alternate sides at a steady pace.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your hips low and level with your shoulders.
2. Keep your core braced and shoulders stable.
3. Breathe steadily as you alternate legs.
4. Keep movements controlled to hold form.

instructions:
1. Start in a plank with hands slightly wider than shoulders and feet together.
2. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
3. Bend your elbows at about 45 degrees and lower your chest toward the floor.
4. Stop when your chest is just above the floor.
5. Push through your hands to extend your arms back to the start.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees to the body.
2. Exhale as you push up and inhale as you lower.
3. Keep your head aligned with your spine.
4. Brace your core to keep your hips from sagging.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
2. Place your hands behind your head with elbows wide.
3. Lift your upper back off the floor and rotate to bring your right elbow toward the ceiling.
4. Squeeze your obliques at the top.
5. Lower your upper back with control, then repeat to the other side.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you lift and rotate, inhale as you lower.
2. Do not pull on your neck, let your core do the work.
3. Focus on rotating the torso, not just lifting.
4. Keep the movement slow and controlled.
